next.reason: 1985: 'The permanent error condition remains in effect for all subsequent input-output operations on the file unless an implementor-defined'; 2023: 'If the I-O status value does indicate a fatal EC-I-O exception condition, the implementor determines what action is taken'. 2023 makes a permanent error a fatal EC-I-O condition whose follow-up action is implementor-determined. No candidate keeps the 1985 rule that the error persists for later operations on the file.
